ownmods.timber.title: Timber
ownmods.timber.description: Break one log to fell a recognised tree and its assigned leaves. Alpha: test on a world copy first.
ownmods.timber.enabled.tip: Turns the entire Timber feature on or off after saving.
ownmods.timber.leaves.tip: Removes assigned natural leaves. Natural drops without axe wear; no Fortune/Silk Touch bonus for leaves.
ownmods.timber.replant.tip: Plants matching saplings at the trunk base after a complete felling. A 2×2 base receives four saplings. The Consume saplings option controls the cost. Empty planting positions and suitable ground are required.
ownmods.timber.sneak: Sneak to break a single block
ownmods.timber.sneak.tip: Hold the sneak key to bypass Timber for this break.
ownmods.timber.axe.tip: Only enabled axe types trigger Timber. All off means no trigger. Logs apply normal tool wear.
ownmods.timber.consume.tip: Optional replanting cost. Off: free. On: uses fresh sapling drops, then your inventory; skips planting if there are not enough. Only applies when replanting is on. Creative mode remains free.
ownmods.timber.replant.no_saplings: Replanting needs %s matching saplings. Disable material cost using the chest icon.
ownmods.timber.replant.blocked: Replanting: the original planting position is not empty.
ownmods.timber.replant.bad_soil: Replanting: the ground at the trunk base is unsuitable for this sapling.
ownmods.timber.replant.unloaded: Replanting: the planting area is not loaded.
ownmods.timber.replant.failed: Replanting failed. See latest.log for details.
